displayName.ja: 【血塗れのバレンタイン】 ソニア

profile.ja: 人魔問わず斬り殺す殺人鬼として、米連国内で恐れられた人物。残虐非道な行いで有名であり、捕まるまでの間に１００人以上の人魔が惨殺された。その手口から、魔族の犯行ではないかと目されていたが、捕まったのは教師として働く女性ソニア。逮捕時には血しぶきを浴びているショッキングな姿が米連中に放映された。すぐに裁判が行われ、死刑になった――ということになっているが、それは表向き。彼女の才能に目をつけた米連の研究者が持ちかけた取引にのり、ソニアは人造人間になって生まれ変わった。その後は裏の世界に足を踏み入れ、米連に仇なす魔族や人を切り殺している。冬のある日、本国で護送中に失踪した連続殺人犯が、日本へと逃走して再び殺人を繰り返しているという情報を得た米連は、同じ元殺人鬼のソニアに排除の指示を送る。その犯人が動くと予想された日はバレンタイン当日であった。ソニアは縁遠いと感じていたその日に恋人たちの溢れる街へ殺人犯を狩りに繰り出すことになる。
profile.en: They are a ruthless killer who has been feared throughout the country for their ability to slaughter both humans and demons without hesitation. They are notorious for their brutal methods, and over 100 people have been brutally murdered before they were caught. Due to the nature of their crimes, it was suspected that they might be a demon, but the one who was arrested was a female teacher named Sonia. Her shocking appearance, covered in blood, was broadcasted nationwide. She was quickly put on trial and sentenced to death - or so it seemed. In reality, a researcher from the country who had taken notice of her talents proposed a deal, and Sonia was reborn as an artificial human being. Since then, she has been active in the underworld, killing demons and people who are enemies of the country. One winter day, the country received information that a serial killer who had escaped from prison had fled to Japan and was committing murders again. The country decided to send Sonia, a former serial killer, to eliminate the target. The day the killer was predicted to strike again happened to be Valentine's Day. Sonia would have to hunt down the killer in a city filled with lovers.

name.ja: ブラッドバレンタイン

detail.ja: 科学属性ユニットの会心率を大アップ

text.ja: こんな日に会えるなんて、ツイていたわね。なぁに、チョコが欲しいの？　あげてもいいけど……先に、楽しませてもらおうかしら
text.en: It's nice that we get to meet on a day like this. What's with the stare? Do you want some chocolate? I can give you some, but first... let me have some fun.

text.ja: 知っている？　チョコレートって、隠し味に血を入れることもあるらしいわよ。なに、違うの？　ああ、おまじないの一種なのね……
text.en: You know that chocolate sometimes has a secret ingredient - blood. What's wrong? You didn't know that? It's like a charm, I suppose.

text.ja: この時期は、人が増えるのよね……カップルという意味じゃないわ。人が集まるところには……血を求める連中も集まるものなのよ
text.en: This time of year is when the crowds get bigger... and I don't just mean couples. Where there are crowds, there are also people who crave blood.

text.ja: はぁ……ひと仕事したら、熱くなってきたわ……ええ、心も身体も。滾って仕方ないわ……あなたが傍にいるせいよ、責任を取りなさい
text.en: Sigh... I've gotten a bit heated up after finishing a job... both my heart and body are burning. It's all because you're by my side - you're to blame.

text.ja: あら、雪……いいわよね、雪って。真っ白に積もった雪に、真っ赤な花が咲くのよ……あれ、とっても綺麗よね？
text.en: Ah, snow... it's nice, isn't it? The pure white snow and the bright red flowers that bloom in it... they're really beautiful, don't you think?

text.ja: ……お腹が空いたわね。仕事する気分でもないし、ちょっと付き合いなさい。ご馳走してあげるわ
text.en: I'm a bit hungry... and I'm not in the mood for work. Let's take a break and have some fun. I'll treat you to a feast.

text.ja: ほかの女相手だと、私ほど刺激がないでしょう？　あなたを心の底から満足させられるのは、私だけ……もちろん、逆もね……
text.en: I'm sure it's not as stimulating with other women, is it? I'm the only one who can satisfy you to the core... and vice versa, of course.

text.ja: なぁに？　このくらいくっついていたほうが、周りに混ざって、気づかれにくいのよ……ほら、しっかり抱き締めなさい
text.en: What's wrong? It's better if we stick together like this - it's easier to blend in and avoid detection. Come on, hold me tighter.

text.ja: あなたの場合、殺したいって気持ちより……鳴かせたいって気持ちのほうが、大きいのよね……ほら、行くわよ。たっぷり鳴かせてあげる……♪
text.en: With you, the desire to make me scream is stronger than the desire to kill, isn't it? Well, let's go... I'll make sure you hear my voice loud and clear.

text.ja: ふふっ、萎えさせたら承知しないんだから……今夜一晩、枯れるまで抜いてあげる……存分にイッていいわよ♪
text.en: Don't worry, I won't let you go limp... tonight, I'll keep you going until you're exhausted. Feel free to cum as much as you want.
